items.title: Subagents vs Agent Skills: Executing Reusable Knowledge for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
items.title_zh: 子智能体与智能体技能：为长时程智能体任务执行可复用知识
items.summary: The paper compares executing reusable skill packages by loading their instructions into an agent's context against invoking them as subagents with fresh context windows. It reports that subagent execution works better when skills expose clear input-output contracts and encode procedural knowledge, at the cost of extra coordination tokens.

items.title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
items.title_zh: ZGCM-1：面向数学与智能体搜索的全开放高效基础模型
items.summary: ZGCM-1 is a fully open 7B dense foundation model trained from scratch with interleaved gated sliding-window and full attention, an FP8 Muon optimizer, progressive 16K-64K-256K context scaling and agentic co-training. The authors report performance competitive with much larger models such as Qwen3-235B-A22B and GLM-5.1 on mathematical reasoning and agentic search suites, a roughly 4.2x efficiency improvement in 16K pre-training time-to-loss, and open release of weights from all training stages, intermediate checkpoints, training code, per-stage data and recipes, and W&B logs.

items.title: The Immutable Past: Formalizing State Mutability and Conflict Resolution in Mutable RAG
items.title_zh: 不可变的过去：形式化可变 RAG 中的状态可变性与冲突消解
items.summary: The paper formalizes State Mutability in mutable RAG memory for long-horizon agents, identifying Semantic Shadowing, in which conflicting historical observations statistically dominate recent updates, and proves that standard dense retrieval suffers Asymptotic Recall Decay and a Majority Vote Trap. It introduces GC-Mem, an inference-time consistency protocol that pairs a temporal dominance operator with contradiction detection and recovers over 90% conflict-resolution accuracy on a benchmark of 137,760 memory chunks.

items.title: Glyph: A Multi-Strategy Agentic System for Column Description and Sensitivity-Ontology Tagging of Enterprise Data Catalogs
items.title_zh: Glyph：面向企业数据目录列描述与敏感本体标注的多策略智能体系统
items.summary: Glyph frames column description generation and column type annotation for enterprise data catalogs as cooperating LLM agents orchestrated as stateful graphs, using active RAG over pipeline source code and three parallel tagging strategies fused with reciprocal rank fusion. Fine-tuning a 6-layer MiniLM metadata encoder lifts same-tag retrieval from NDCG@10 0.55 to 0.92 on an in-distribution held-out split.

items.title: SPINE: Measuring LLM Sycophancy under Sustained Multi-Turn Pressure
items.title_zh: SPINE：衡量 LLM 在持续多轮压力下的谄媚行为
items.summary: SPINE uses an LLM proxy as a persistent but mistaken user that adaptively challenges a target model for up to 25 turns on 100 false presuppositions and 100 unethical queries. Across seven models, collapse rates rise from 0%-57% within five turns to 20%-97% within 25 turns, and the correct position remains represented in reasoning traces in 50%-89% of analyzed collapse turns.

items.title: A*-Thought-V2: Efficient Latent Reasoning via Geometric Dynamics of LLM
items.title_zh: A*-Thought-V2：基于 LLM 几何动态的高效潜在推理
items.summary: A*-Thought-V2 treats chain-of-thought as a hidden-state trajectory in a 3D PCA space, keeping aligned steps as explicit text and compressing deviating steps into latent tokens. On Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B across six benchmarks it improves average accuracy by up to 2.6% while cutting response length by up to half.

items.title: Benchmarking Agentic HLS Design Tasks With HLS-Eval
items.title_zh: 用 HLS-Eval 对智能体化 HLS 设计任务进行基准测试
items.summary: The authors extend the open HLS-Eval benchmark with a mini-swe-agent pipeline in which agents edit files, call a C++ compiler for self-verification and iterate on designs while logging cost, token use and iteration count. Initial results show open LLMs with the agent framework solve all easy HLS code-generation tasks, indicating the benchmark needs to be harder.

items.title: HLSFactory-Agent: Large-Scale Agentic HLS Dataset Construction from Academic and Open-Source Projects
items.title_zh: HLSFactory-Agent：从学术与开源项目大规模构建智能体化 HLS 数据集
items.summary: HLSFactory-Agent is an LLM agent that extracts standalone designs from large codebases and builds and evaluates each design inside Docker using the open-source Pi agent framework. Users provide a GitHub link or code directory and receive a design collection compatible with the HLSFactory dataset framework.

items.title: A Verifier Can Leak the Answer: Diagnosability Before Optimization in Closed-Loop Agent Debugging
items.title_zh: 验证器可能泄露答案：闭环智能体调试中的可诊断性先于优化
items.summary: The paper reports a closed-loop agent debugger case in which exact minimum hitting set and a propagation-aware greedy method returned identical supports in 12/12 development cases, and an audit found that exact-anchor predicates produced the planted pair in 9/9 cases. It proposes a support-gated verification contract that checks evidence eligibility and non-revelation before optimizing the component selector.

items.title: Can LLMs in Draft-Verify-Revise Pipelines Resolve Deictic Ambiguity?
items.title_zh: 草拟-验证-修订流水线中的 LLM 能解决指示性歧义吗？
items.summary: The study tests draft-verify-revise pipelines on a synthetic dataset of 10 base examples rendered in three conditions, finding that models at different stages can resolve context-dependent expressions differently and produce deictic shifts. Across six models and 21 reasoning-effort configurations, balanced accuracy ranged from 0.156, below chance, to near-perfect; GPT-5.2 rose from 0.156 without reasoning to 0.942 at its highest effort, while Gemini 3 Pro stayed above 0.94 at every level.

items.title: MindTopo: Can Foundation Models Reason in Topological Space?
items.title_zh: MindTopo：基础模型能在拓扑空间中推理吗？
items.summary: MindTopo is a benchmark of topological intuition across continuity, separation, order, enclosure and knots, with 11,030 instances in 13 procedurally generated task types evaluated at reasoning and planning levels. Across 14 MLLMs, every model performs better on reasoning than planning and the best remains far below human performance, while supervised fine-tuning and RL on Qwen3-VL-2B improve reasoning more than planning.

items.title: Anchoring Clinical Events in Time: UID-Preserving Multimodal Reconstruction and Source-Grounded Adjudication
items.title_zh: 将临床事件锚定在时间中：保留 UID 的多模态重建与来源可追溯裁定
items.summary: The paper presents a UID-preserving framework that links each narrative clinical event to its source span and retains that identity through text-only estimation, structured-evidence retrieval, timestamped source-row grounding and joint revision. Across six open-weight models and 40 mixed-critical-care summaries, multimodal GLM 5.2 revision improved temporal agreement without reducing event recovery and performed competitively with clinician annotations, while the UID and judge pipeline demonstrated 43% increased event recovery.

items.title: RA-CoA: Training-free Fashion Image Captioning via Retrieval-Augmented Chain-of-Attributes
items.title_zh: RA-CoA：通过检索增强属性链实现免训练时尚图像描述
items.summary: RA-CoA is a training-free framework that retrieves relevant attribute sets from a product knowledge base and then performs attribute-level reasoning with a frozen vision-language model to generate fashion captions. Across diverse VLM families and prompting paradigms, it reports an average 26.3% METEOR gain over zero-shot captioning.

items.title: Another Blueprint In The Wall: How to Ask Frontier AI Like a Kid?
items.title_zh: 墙上的另一张蓝图：如何像孩子一样向前沿 AI 提问？
items.summary: The paper reports ten sessions per model type for six frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI and Google DeepMind, using a three-stage prompt sequence, and finds that a school-audience framing led responses to converge on a shared architecture motif built around persistent latent state, adaptive computation, memory, specialist routing, verification and delayed decoding. Control runs without the school framing produced substantially more heterogeneous answers, and the author uses the term epistemic jailbreak for the loss of technical provenance as requested specificity increases.

items.title: TriCalRAG: A Three-Strategy, Retrieval-Augmented Benchmark for On-Premise LLM-Based Root Cause Analysis in AIOps
items.title_zh: TriCalRAG：面向 AIOps 本地化 LLM 根因分析的三策略检索增强基准
items.summary: TriCalRAG is a reproducible benchmark for on-premise log-anomaly detection and root-cause analysis across BGL, HDFS, Thunderbird and OpenStack, comparing Qwen2.5-14B and Mistral-Small-22B under zero-shot, few-shot and RAG prompting; Mistral-Small attains higher macro-averaged F1 (0.644 versus 0.560) while Qwen provides roughly twice the throughput. Supplementary runs with 4-bit Llama-3.1-70B and Claude Haiku 4.5 found RAG improved F1 on all four datasets for both models, with Claude's aggregate F1 rising from 0.566 to 0.695 as estimated API cost rose from $0.94 to $2.15 per 1,000 incidents.

items.title: APPSim-Bench: Bridging Real-world Apps and Reproducible Evaluation for Mobile GUI Agents
items.title_zh: APPSim-Bench：连接真实应用与可复现评估的移动 GUI 智能体基准
items.summary: The benchmark uses controllable simulated apps that preserve task-relevant interaction logic to evaluate mobile GUI agents reproducibly, covering 557 tasks across 17 Chinese and English apps. Across 19 agents, the best completes only 50.27% of tasks and 28.55% of tasks are solved by no agent.

items.title: TDDN: Text-aligned Diffused DINO Network for Puzzle Understanding
items.title_zh: TDDN：面向拼图理解的对齐扩散 DINO 网络
items.summary: TDDN fuses DINOv3 and CleanDIFT features into a perception encoder aligned with RoBERTa-L, using frozen backbones and about 590K alignment pairs. It surpasses CLIP ViT-L/14 on image-text retrieval and more than triples CLIP's dense-prediction accuracy on ADE20K and COCO-Stuff.

items.title: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Models: On-Policy Correction Helps Weaker Models Catch Up Where Imitation Fails
items.title_zh: 协同演化支架与模型：在线策略纠错让弱模型在模仿失败处追赶
items.summary: The paper examines how automated harness evolution and lightweight fine-tuning should be combined across seven enterprise agent tasks, finding that imitating a stronger expert's full trajectories regresses performance by 4 to 30 points. It proposes an on-policy expert-correction pipeline that rewrites only the failing turn in the weaker model's own rollout.

items.title: Harness or Model? Isolating the Harness Effect in Agentic Coding with a Contamination-Controlled Private Suite
items.title_zh: 支架还是模型？在受污染控制的私有套件中分离智能体编码的支架效应
items.summary: The study runs paired same-model contrasts on a private, contamination-controlled suite of 256 repository and contest tasks to test whether vendor-native agent harnesses hold an average advantage. Neither contrast resolves one, though the Opus 4.8 average combines a 9.0-point deficit on repository tasks with a 23.7-point lead on contest tasks.

items.title: DriftNet: A Dual-Head Trajectory Transformer for Detecting and Localizing Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: DriftNet：用于检测与定位 LLM 智能体提示注入的双头轨迹 Transformer
items.summary: DriftNet is a dual-head trajectory Transformer that reads a logged tool-call trajectory and, in one forward pass, classifies it as compromised or not while labeling each step as benign, injection point, hijacked or failed injection. On the task-disjoint split of AgentDrift it reports trajectory-level F1 of 0.983 and exact injection-point recovery on 98.7% of attacked trajectories without access to the agent's model.

items.title: Think Before You Link: Rarity, Reasoning, and Retrieval in Multilingual Entity Linking
items.title_zh: 链接之前先思考：多语言实体链接中的稀有性、推理与检索
items.summary: The paper broadens entity rarity beyond popularity metrics using knowledge-graph structural metrics, finding state-of-the-art entity-linking accuracy drops by 15.4-39.9% on the resulting rare-entity slices. A training-free framework in which a reasoning-capable vision-language model iteratively searches and reasons over Wikipedia improves over the prior state of the art by 6.9% overall and up to 23.3% on rare entities.

items.title: GTA: Graph Theory Agent and Benchmark for Algorithmic Graph Reasoning with LLMs
items.title_zh: GTA：面向 LLM 算法图推理的图论智能体与基准
items.summary: The authors introduce GT Bench, a benchmark of 24 classical graph problems in 44 task-structure settings with over 100,000 examples across four input representations, and find that LLM accuracy is strongly tied to representation and shifts with graph density, size and topology. They also propose GTA, which pairs a preference-trained representation selector with plan-and-decompose scaffolding around a frozen executor LLM, lifting Phi-4 from 53.5% to 69.1% on the easy split and from 33.0% to 41.5% on the hard split.

items.title: $τ$-Elicitation: Benchmarking multi-turn entity extraction in voice agents
items.title_zh: τ-Elicitation：语音智能体多轮实体抽取基准
items.summary: τ-Elicitation is a 200-task voice benchmark spanning 10 entity types, controlled difficulty, caller realisms and three environments, where a matched text agent passes all tasks but four voice configurations achieve robust exact success from 0.14 to 0.41. A scaffold that prescribes spelling, read-back, correction and confirmation raises robust Pass^3 by 14-31 points at a cost of 21-28 seconds per call.

items.title: AutoTailor: Automatic, User-Aligned Capability Selection and Adaptation for Web Agents
items.title_zh: AutoTailor：面向 Web 智能体的自动、用户对齐能力选择与适配
items.summary: AutoTailor is a meta-agentic framework that converts web trajectories into parameterized MCP browser-automation APIs, filters them for granularity, redundancy and usage likelihood, and dynamically reselects capabilities as task outcomes are observed. On 106 WebArena Postmill tasks, offline filtering cuts 1,283 unrefined APIs to 87 and dynamic reselection yields a 33-API set that reaches 90.6% correctness with ReAct fallback versus 87.5% for ReAct alone, while reducing request-token cost by 57.8% and latency by 29.4%.

items.title: GraMRAG: Orchestrating Multi-Agent Multi-Step Reasoning via Graph Memory with Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: GraMRAG：通过图记忆与强化学习编排多智能体多步推理
items.summary: GraMRAG is a graph-memory-guided multi-agent RAG framework that formalizes agent reasoning as a dynamic directed acyclic graph, explicitly modeling action-observation dependencies to reduce state blindness and redundant retrieval. It combines a vision-text bridged ReAct-style toolchain with Topology-Aware Policy Optimization for critical-path identification and node pruning, reporting state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon multimodal reasoning benchmarks.

items.title: ANASSA: An Agentic AI Orchestration Framework for Spatial Intelligence
items.title_zh: ANASSA：面向空间智能的智能体 AI 编排框架
items.summary: ANASSA is an architecture-level agentic orchestration framework for geospatial workflows that integrates structured spatial reasoning, multi-agent orchestration, execution feedback, authoritative spatial validation, provenance, uncertainty handling and human decision authority. It specifies eleven components across four layers and a six-step Geospatial AI Cognitive Loop, and notes that empirical evaluation is reserved for implementation and deployment studies.

items.title: El Agente Potente: High-Throughput Agentic Atomistic Simulations
items.title_zh: El Agente Potente：高通量智能体原子尺度模拟
items.summary: El Agente Potente is an agentic system for machine-learning interatomic potential simulations that combines typed execution graphs, in which LLMs are restricted to planning and routing while deterministic Python components perform computation and validation, with a complementary coding mode for customized workflows. It is demonstrated on computational materials discovery, molecular energy-landscape exploration and adsorption and catalytic reaction workflows, alongside benchmarks of reproducibility and LLM token cost.

items.title: Jakeschincariol/linkedin-agent-skill
items.title_zh: linkedin-agent-skill：11 个运营 LinkedIn 账号的 Claude 技能
items.summary: A Python repository bundling eleven free Claude skills for running a LinkedIn account, covering posts built on 21 hook formulas, replies, profile scoring, weekly plans and a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint.

items.title: undefined-ui/second-brain-os
items.title_zh: second-brain-os：可自我维护的 AI 第二大脑模板
items.summary: A starter kit for a self-maintaining AI second brain, bundling a guide, starter vault, agent skills and scripts for a self-organizing knowledge base in Claude Code and Obsidian.

items.title: aliyun/ai-agent-handbook
items.title_zh: aliyun/ai-agent-handbook：企业级 AI 智能体全生命周期实践指南
items.summary: A JavaScript guide for enterprises that covers how to build AI agents through their entire lifecycle.

items.title: Clearailhc/clearai-dsh
items.title_zh: ClearAI：以本体为核心的原生 DSH 插件
items.summary: ClearAI is an ontology-first DSH agent preset that turns evidence-checked research into a browsable domain ontology.

items.title: youngyangyang04/llm-master
items.title_zh: llm-master：大模型全栈学习路线与中文教程
items.summary: A Chinese-language full-stack LLM curriculum that runs from beginner material to production practice, covering prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, MCP, fine-tuning, model deployment, Transformers, AI coding and interview preparation.

items.title: AetherLabsAI/RSIAgent
items.title_zh: RSIAgent：无需训练的多智能体递归自我改进框架
items.summary: RSIAgent is a training-free multi-agent framework for recursive self-improvement in new environments, using broad-then-deep autonomous exploration and reusable memory.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra：面向工作的下一代智能
items.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Astra as its most capable model for business, citing advanced reasoning, computer use, and stronger writing and design judgment.

items.title: Cognition launches new SWE-2 model, Rivaling Fable 5.1 and GPT-Astra
items.title_zh: Cognition 推出新模型 SWE-2，对标 Fable 5.1 与 GPT-Astra
items.summary: Cognition introduced SWE-2, describing it as its most advanced coding model yet and claiming highly competitive agentic coding performance against Fable 5.1 and GPT-Astra.

items.title: Enemray: Toward Capable Language Models for Hassaniya
items.title_zh: Enemray：迈向具备能力的哈桑尼亚语语言模型
items.summary: Enemray is a Hassaniya-centric language model trained with a stability-plasticity objective that separates language acquisition from behavioral specialization through layer-selective continual pretraining and supervised post-training with policy-generated replay. It reports the strongest English-to-Hassaniya translation among the compared open and proprietary models and the highest overall score on Mauritanian translation error detection, while retaining most general capabilities of its instruction-tuned base on mathematical reasoning, knowledge, code generation and function calling.

items.title: Introducing the Agents API
items.title_zh: 推出 Agents API
items.summary: OpenAI launches the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness for orchestration, long-running sessions and tool use, aimed at building and launching cloud agents.

items.title: Now everyone can put data to work
items.title_zh: 现在人人都能让数据发挥作用
items.summary: OpenAI introduces the Data agent in ChatGPT Work, which connects company data, surfaces insights and builds interactive dashboards through natural-language requests.

items.title: 1Password increases engineering productivity 21% with Codex
items.title_zh: 1Password 借助 Codex 将工程生产力提升 21%
items.summary: OpenAI reports that engineers at 1Password use Codex to build new features and internal tools rapidly, reaching production readiness while maintaining rigorous security policies, with the case study citing a 21% productivity increase.

items.title: Real-SWE: Benchmarking AI models on private, real-world, enterprise codebases
items.title_zh: Real-SWE：在私有真实企业代码库上评测 AI 模型
items.summary: Real-SWE benchmarks frontier AI models on private codebases drawn from real companies' production systems, covering seventeen models and twenty-five tasks.
